# Export4j

> Export4j is an open-source Java 21 document layout and generation engine. Use fluent Java APIs or XML templates to generate PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, SVG and PNG for reports, forms and structured documents.

The current published release candidate is 0.1.0-rc.2. There is no stable release yet, and APIs may change. Export4j's own code and documentation use Apache-2.0; third-party libraries, fonts and other resources retain their respective licenses.

Fonts and resources are supplied explicitly by the application. Generation does not require Office, a browser process or a printer driver. The optional visual template designer uses a browser.

Import, editing and conversion apply to documented input subsets. Arbitrary PDF or Word files are not guaranteed to round-trip without losses; DOCX and PDF pagination may differ. PDF recovery does not perform OCR, and offline HTML/CSS import does not execute JavaScript or reproduce a full browser. Large-document entry points require finite resource budgets and do not guarantee arbitrary content sizes within a fixed heap.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/getting-started): Maven/Gradle dependencies, explicit fonts and a complete Java PDF example.
- [快速开始](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/zh/getting-started): 中文安装说明、字体配置及完整 PDF 示例。
- [FAQ](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/faq): Runtime requirements, fonts, format limits, large documents and commercial use.
- [常见问题](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/zh/docs/faq): 环境要求、字体、转换限制及商用许可。
- [Documentation index](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/README): Task-based navigation with English and Chinese primary guides; Chinese-only references are labeled.
- [Capability matrix](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/capabilities-api): Current entry points and supported subsets; consult the linked API guide for a specific feature.

## Authoring and templates

- [Java authoring](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/authoring-api): Semantic documents, report content and export.
- [Fluent API](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/fluent-api): Builders, configuration and convenience entry points.
- [Fonts and text](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/text-api): Explicit font loading, fallback, shaping and missing-glyph behavior.
- [XML templates](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/xml-template-api): Variables, conditions, loops, tables and registered includes.
- [Template resource bundles](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/xml-template-bundle-api): Editable XML and resources in ZIP packages.
- [Tables](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/table-api): Semantic tables and pagination.
- [Page-at-a-time export](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/paged-document-api): Incremental layout output and block sources, with memory and replay limits.
- [Streaming and PDF spooling](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/streaming-replay-api): Table-row sources, stable-snapshot replay and disk-indexed PDF output.

## Formats and conversion

- [Import, edit and convert](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/document-conversion-api): Supported conversion paths and explicit loss policies.
- [DOCX semantics](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/docx-semantic-api): Supported Word structures, semantic editing and export.
- [HTML/CSS import](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/html-import-api): Offline semantic and explicit layout subsets.
- [HTML and Markdown export](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/web-export-api): Semantic output, fallback policies and diagnostics.
- [PDF processing](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/pdf-adapter-api): Existing-PDF operations and their boundaries.
- [PDF semantic recovery](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/pdf-semantic-import-api): Editable structure recovery and uncertainty reporting.
- [PDF standards and signing](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/pdf-standards-api): Supported PDF/A, PDF/UA and PAdES output paths and validation requirements.

## Project and evidence

- [Source repository](https://github.com/mirakyux/export4j): Source, issues and releases.
- [RC2 release notes](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/releases/0.1.0-rc.2): Changes, validation scope and known limitations.
- [Maven Central BOM](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.mirakyux.export4j/export4j-bom/0.1.0-rc.2): Published module version alignment.
- [Examples](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/examples): Runnable tasks and output locations.
- [Dependencies and licenses](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/dependencies): Third-party dependencies and distribution obligations.
- [Capability gaps](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/docs/capability-gaps): Remaining work and acceptance boundaries.
- [Verification records (Chinese)](https://export4j.mirakyux.com/zh/docs/verification/): Historical checks and evidence; each record applies to its stated version and scope.
